model.name: SAP Centralized Identity and Access Management - Project Repository
model.documentation: Standalone ArchiMate model for the Centralized Identity and Access Management sub-project: Azure Active Directory as master identity source, federated via SAP IAS (shared per application: S/4HANA and SuccessFactors) for Single Sign-On, and provisioned via SAP IPS (shared per application) into SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP SuccessFactors, each spanning Development, Acceptance, and Production landscapes. Generated: 2026-08-13.
